QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Eye for an Eye
QuestInfo.0: Tepes wanted to return the favor. \r\nThere WAS something he could help you with...
QuestInfo.1: You asked Tepes to set up a meeting with Gilberto of the Daniella Merchant Union. He agreed, though he said it'd be difficult. He told you to go to the white building east of fountain square.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Tepes to set up a meeting with Gilberto of the Daniella Merchant Union. He agreed, though he said it'd be difficult. He told you where to go. \r\nBut Gilberto won't talk to anyone without an appointment. Argh!

npc.0: I'll let the Merchant Union know so you'll be able to get in. Please be polite when you talk to Gilberto. He is quite powerful in Commerci.
